connection.offlineBody: Your Journeys are safe on this phone and everything here still works. The coach and your Circle need the connection, so they are waiting until it is back.
connection.coachTitle: The coach can't reach the server
connection.coachBody: It will not start a plan it cannot finish properly, so it is waiting rather than guessing. Your Journeys are safe on this phone.
connection.coachLostBody: Nothing you wrote became a Journey. Try again in a moment and it will pick up from your first sentence.
